data.rationale: The proposed workflow has the same steps in the same order as the true one (Book > Hotels, type and pick the destination, choose check-in/out dates, Search, sort by price, filter, reserve). Its parameters are concrete and cover everything that varies, so an automation could be built from it. One small difference: it puts guests/rooms before Search instead of after, which is fine since they are optional.
